reviews.text: Wide variety of products, welcoming service and good prices.
This is one of my favorite pet stores. I buy most of my guinea pig's food here. The hay is also very fresh, and the prices are reasonable.
Lovely place with people to match

Since I got my rabbit, I've always gone to this store. The girls are very friendly. There was a gentleman who was impeccable, but he moved to another store, but the service is very good.

Regarding the products, I find everything I need, and sometimes with discounts.

Keep up the good work.
We bought a very ugly but cute funny pig for our dog hahaha! The sales person in the store are friendly.
Always very friendly and with a great variety of pet products.
Very small store with few items on offer. The prices are not outlet prices.
Excellent service
The staff were very friendly and loved my personality and my dog's too :)
Stopped in while on vacation and found some lovely treats for our pups, very nice shop
Has great stuff for such a small store
A nice pet shop with friendly staff and a lot of goodwill
The staff were amazing, extremely kind, and helped me choose the necessary items for my pet. They treated my kitten very well, and I hope to return many more times with Micka and Rafa.
Soooo friendly

The best selection I've seen in the area, even though it's right in the city center

Very nice, polite staff, happy to help and share their experience

They have the best prices, a large selection, and they're open until 7pm, which isn't often found
They’ve been so helpful while I’ve been in Lisbon. They have a great selection of brands too.
Excellent service! I highly recommend it!
It has the basics and good prices.
Small shop but has the essentials for cats and dogs.
Excellent and helpful staff!! many choices of everything, I even found a special travel bag for my dog!
Very friendly staff and pet food selection.
They have Lily’s organic dog food and were open till 7pm
Good little pet shop, good pet food brands like Royal Canin and Purina Pro Plan as well as good wet food, treats, etc.
It's a small, well-stocked pet shop with friendly staff.

I have recently gotten a small puppy and I came here for all my puppy’s supplies and I was amazed by how knowledgeable the team running this place was. I asked for recommendations that matched the size and type of puppy I got (pic attached) and the ladies working the front desk were amazing at knowing exactly what to recommend. I definitely will want to come back here. Thank you!
Super friendly staff and nice selection
The prices listed have a 10% discount, there's a variety of animals available, and the staff are friendly.
